name: Dagger
description: A simple blade weapon used for close combat.

name: Shortsword
description: A martial melee weapon with a short blade.

name: Longsword
description: A martial melee weapon with a long blade.

name: Greatsword
description: A large two-handed blade.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive two-handed axe.

name: Shortbow
description: A simple ranged weapon.

name: Longbow
description: A martial ranged weapon with extended range.

name: Leather Armor
description: Light armor made from softened and flexible leather.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy armor made of interlocking metal rings.

name: Plate Armor
description: Heavy armor consisting of shaped, interlocking metal plates.

name: Shield
description: A shield provides +2 to AC.

name: Longsword +1
description: A magically enhanced longsword that provides a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Flame Tongue
description: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits.

effects.description: Deals an extra 2d6 fire damage when activated

name: Vorpal Sword
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage. When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads.

effects.description: Ignores resistance to slashing damage. On natural 20, severs head of creature with heads.

name: Armor +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible with you. You remain invisible until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

effects.description: Can turn invisible as an action

name: Belt of Giant Strength (Hill)
description: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no effect on you.

name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Fire Resistance
description: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.

name: Cursed Sword of Vengeance
description: This sword appears to be a +1 longsword. However, once you attune to it, you are cursed until you are targeted by remove curse. While cursed, you are unwilling to part with the sword, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this one.

curse.description: Cursed - unwilling to part with sword
curse.effect: Disadvantage on attacks with other weapons. Cannot voluntarily remove sword.

name: Armor of Vulnerability
description: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. However, you have vulnerability to the other two types. Once you don the armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by remove curse or similar magic.

curse.effect: Resistance to one physical damage type, vulnerability to the other two. Cannot remove without Remove Curse.

name: Scroll of Fireball
description: A spell scroll containing the fireball spell (3rd level).

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents.

effects.description: Can hold 500 lbs of items in extradimensional space

name: Club
description: A simple bludgeoning weapon.

name: Mace
description: A simple metal-headed weapon.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A simple wooden staff.

name: Spear
description: A simple piercing weapon with range.

name: Javelin
description: A simple thrown spear.

name: Rapier
description: A finesse martial weapon favored by duelists.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved martial blade.

name: Warhammer
description: A one-handed martial bludgeoning weapon.

name: Battleaxe
description: A one-handed martial axe.

name: Flail
description: A spiked ball and chain weapon.

name: Glaive
description: A polearm with extended reach.

name: Halberd
description: A versatile polearm with axe and spike.

name: Pike
description: A long spear with exceptional reach.

name: Lance
description: A mounted combat weapon with reach.

name: Maul
description: A massive two-handed hammer.

name: Morningstar
description: A spiked mace.

name: Light Crossbow
description: A simple mechanical ranged weapon.

name: Sling
description: A simple ranged weapon using stones or bullets.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A powerful martial crossbow.

name: Hand Crossbow
description: A small one-handed crossbow.

name: Padded Armor
description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting.

name: Studded Leather Armor
description: Leather armor reinforced with metal studs.

name: Hide Armor
description: Crude armor made from thick furs and pelts.

name: Scale Mail
description: Armor consisting of a coat of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal.

name: Breastplate
description: A fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather.

name: Half Plate
description: Partial plate armor with leather for joints.

name: Ring Mail
description: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it.

name: Splint Armor
description: Armor made of narrow vertical metal strips riveted to a backing.

name: Tower Shield
description: A massive shield providing superior protection.

name: Frost Brand
description: When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of you. While you wield it, you have resistance to fire damage. In freezing temperatures, the blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. When you hit with an attack using this magic sword, the target takes an extra 1d6 cold damage.

name: Sword of Sharpness
description: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20, that target takes an extra 14 slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs.

name: Holy Avenger
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a fiend or an undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 radiant damage. While you hold the drawn sword, it creates an aura in a 10-foot radius around you. You and all creatures friendly to you in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Oathbow
description: When you nock an arrow on this bow, it whispers in Elvish, 'Swift defeat to my enemies.' When you use this weapon to make a ranged attack, you can speak its command word to make the target your sworn enemy. When you hit your sworn enemy, it takes an extra 3d6 piercing damage. You have advantage on attack rolls against your sworn enemy. Your sworn enemy remains so until it dies or until dawn seven days later.

name: Armor of Invulnerability
description: You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor. Additionally, you can use an action to make yourself immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Elven Chain
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you wear this armor. You are considered proficient with this armor even if you lack proficiency with medium armor.

name: Adamantine Armor
description: This armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Mithral Armor
description: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.

name: Ring of Spell Storing
description: This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 5th level into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the ring.

name: Ring of Regeneration
description: While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes, provided that you have at least 1 hit point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 hit point the whole time.

name: Ring of Three Wishes
description: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the wish spell from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

name: Ring of Fire Resistance
description: You have resistance to fire damage while wearing this ring.

name: Cloak of Displacement
description: While you wear this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while you are incapacitated, restrained, or otherwise unable to move.

name: Cloak of Invisibility
description: While wearing this cloak, you can pull its hood over your head to cause yourself to become invisible. While you are invisible, anything you are carrying or wearing is invisible with you. You become visible when you cease wearing the hood. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.

name: Boots of Speed
description: While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your walking speed, and any creature that makes an opportunity attack against you has disadvantage on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect. When the boots' property has been used for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function until you finish a long rest.

name: Boots of Levitation
description: While you wear these boots, you can use an action to cast the levitate spell on yourself at will.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

name: Amulet of Health
description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

name: Periapt of Health
description: You are immune to contracting any disease while you wear this pendant. If you are already infected with a disease, the effects of the disease are suppressed you while you wear the pendant.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
description: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. In addition, whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, double the number of hit points it restores.

name: Portable Hole
description: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter. You can use an action to unfold a portable hole and place it on or against a solid surface, whereupon the portable hole creates an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep.

name: Deck of Many Things
description: Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have only thirteen cards, but the rest have twenty-two. Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly.

name: Staff of Power
description: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. The staff has 20 charges for various properties.

name: Wand of Fireballs
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the fireball spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.
